external_model_review.reviewer: GPT-6 Astra Pro, isolated public-packet reviewer A; GPT-6 Astra Pro, isolated public-packet reviewer B
external_model_review.method: Fresh full-corpus review from public-only reviewer attestations; raw source JSON and SHA-256 are preserved. No earlier decisions are carried forward and no decisions are corrected by the importer.
external_model_review.note: Every public packet has a fresh decision bound to preserved raw reviewer output. Public-only review is attested by each reviewer; hashes verify integrity, not independence. This scores capability selection, not exact arguments, durable effects, unseen language or live provider latency.
